title: Your first patent hearing: written submissions that survive the hearing officer
summary: A three-hour live training from the Rule 28 hearing notice to the fifteen-day written submission, worked on a real First Examination Report and hearing notice: what to concede, what to amend, how to structure the submission, and what hearing officers actually decide on. Bring your own hearing notice.
format: Real examination report and hearing notice + live drafting
certificate: Certificate of Training on successful completion
